title: Preserve annotated and extensionless paths in ordinary delegation inspected-file lists
outcome: Ordinary delegation results retain legitimate inspected paths such as LICENSE, `LICENSE`, [license](LICENSE), src/state.rs (lines 1-120), and `src/state.rs` — lock path, while excluding no-additional-files explanations, verdict prose and filler; wake counts match the retained evidence.
acceptance: Behavioral parser and result/wake tests retain extensionless and annotated inspected paths without admitting verdict/no-additional-files prose, and preserve ordinary existing path cases.
